tools.description: Prices switching majors, adding a double major, adding a minor, or dropping a double major to a minor: lost-credit cost, extra-semester tuition and living cost, and delayed-graduation opportunity cost, weighed against the salary-delta NPV over a chosen horizon, with a break-even year and a go/no-go against a cheaper minor-or-internship alternative.
tools.data_vintage: 2026 (NCES ~5.1-yr avg time-to-degree; 12-18-credit typical lost-credit band; ~2-3% typical double-major starting-pay premium)
regulatory_citations: Illustrative lost-credit and double-major-premium figures; not a policy database, no live feeds

tools.title: Extra-Semester Funding Gap Planner
tools.description: Models the four cliffs that hit fifth-year and extra-semester students at once: the Pell 600% Lifetime Eligibility Used cap, federal loan aggregate limits, a scholarship semester cutoff, and the SAP 150% maximum timeframe rule. Produces a semester-by-semester fundable/not-fundable breakdown and ranks the cheapest gap-fill order.
tools.data_vintage: 2025–26 federal aggregate loan limits (dependent $31,000 / independent $57,500 undergraduate); Pell LEU 600% (statutory); SAP 150% maximum timeframe. User-override fields on every federal figure.
regulatory_citations: Pell Grant Lifetime Eligibility Used (LEU) 600% cap, Higher Education Act
Federal Direct Loan aggregate limits, 34 CFR 685
Satisfactory Academic Progress 150% maximum timeframe, 34 CFR 668.34

tools.title: Workforce Cost-per-Outcome Ladder
tools.description: Enter costs, enrollment, placements, and retention for up to three programs to produce the full DOL TEGL 6-13 cost ladder (Cost per Participant, Cost per Employed Exiter, Cost per Retained Employee, Cost per Individual with Earnings Increase) plus Cost per Employed Day, benchmark flags, and a side-by-side comparison for a funder-facing one-pager.
tools.data_vintage: DOL ETA TEGL 6-13 cost ladder definitions (statutory framework, changes on TEGL revision cycles); Massachusetts workforce RFP $7,500-per-employment-outcome benchmark; ~$26/employed-day national CPED benchmark. All benchmark figures are user-overridable.
regulatory_citations: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration — TEGL 6-13, WIOA Cost Ladder Performance Measures
Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act (WIOA), Public Law 113-128, enacted July 22, 2014
